description: PUDL US Hourly Electricity Demand by State is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ethan Welty, Zane Selvans (Catalyst Cooperative). Hourly Electricity Demand by State This archive contains the output of the Public Utility Data Liberation (PUDL) Project state electricity demand allocation analysis, as of the v0.4.0 release of the PUDL Python package. Here is the script that produced this output. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
